newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Brent weaker in late trading.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Brent weaker in late trading.

text.p: October Brent futures weakened late on Friday, driven by weaker WTI.
October Brent on SIMEX finished at $19.00 per barrel, down six cents from London's close of $19.06.
WTI on ACCESS last traded at $19.99, down 9 cents from New York's $20.08, which had also seen a fall of 11 cents, as the rally in gasoline prices eased.
Singapore brokers said price could fall, but see technical support at $18.61.
If prices fall below $18.61, there could be be increased selling as players attempt to make short term profits.
October Brent on IPE opened weaker, and last traded at $18.96.
